items.heading: Here Is the Part Most
items.text: Here is the part most "career in event management" pages soften. The version of this career shown in course marketing and social media, and the version a fresh coordinator actually lives through in year one, are describing two different jobs, and the gap between them is the real source of early burnout in this field.

items.heading: "Event Manager Salary in India"
items.text: "Event manager salary in India" is close to a meaningless single number, because most income in this field is project-based, not a flat monthly figure, and the spread between a first-year coordinator and an established planner is enormous.

items.heading: Course Brochures and Coordinator Job
items.text: Course brochures and coordinator job posts lean on words like "creative," "dynamic," and "glamorous industry" far more than they mention 14-hour shifts, vendor no-shows, or chasing a client for a pending payment.

items.heading: The Planner Everyone Sees
items.text: The planner everyone sees is the one presenting the finished result. The planner nobody sees was awake since 5 a.m. fixing a generator failure two hours before the first guest arrived.
